description:
Role: Front End Java Developer 
 Location: Enfield, CT
 Duration: 12+ months 
 Interview: Phone and Skype 
 Job Description 
 5+ years or experience as Front end Java Developer is REQUIRED.
 Strong background in AngularJS or other client-side JavaScript frameworks, jQuery and HTML5 is MUST.
 Understanding of object-oriented design and relational database design .
 Experience developing multi-tier web applications for internal users utilizing AngularJS, jQuery, and SQL is REQUIRED.
 Experience enhancing and supporting internal web applications that support various business activities.
 Design, develop, maintain and enhance systems based on business requirements using approved technologies and coding standards.
 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
